results.question: How many stop events are in the dataset?
results.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS stop_event_count FROM liveboard_records;

results.question: What is the average delay in minutes across all stop events?
results.sql: SELECT AVG(delay_seconds) / 60.0 AS avg_delay_minutes FROM liveboard_records;

results.question: What percentage of trains were on time overall?
results.sql: SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN "Delay Severity" = 'On Time (<2min)' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 1) AS on_time_rate_pct FROM liveboard_records;

results.question: Which single station has the most stop events?
results.sql: SELECT "Stations Name", COUNT(*) AS stop_events FROM liveboard_records GROUP BY "Stations Name" ORDER BY stop_events DESC LIMIT 1;

results.question: What was the longest delay recorded, in minutes?
results.sql: SELECT MAX(delay_seconds) / 60.0 AS max_delay_minutes FROM liveboard_records;

results.question: How many stop events were classified as Severe?
results.sql: SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN "Delay Severity" = 'Severe (>15min)' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS severe_count FROM liveboard_records;

results.question: How many stop events are there in each delay severity category?
results.sql: SELECT "Delay Severity", COUNT(*) AS event_count FROM liveboard_records GROUP BY "Delay Severity" ORDER BY event_count DESC LIMIT 20;

results.question: What is the average delay in minutes at Bruxelles-Central over the whole dataset?
results.sql: SELECT AVG(delay_seconds) / 60.0 AS avg_delay_minutes FROM liveboard_records WHERE "Stations Name" = 'Bruxelles-Central';

results.question: What is the average delay in minutes for Anvers-Central today?
results.sql: SELECT AVG(delay_seconds) / 60.0 AS avg_delay_minutes FROM liveboard_records WHERE "Stations Name" = 'Anvers-Central' AND "Scheduled Date" = (SELECT MAX("Scheduled Date") FROM liveboard_records);

results.question: Which day of the week has the highest average delay?
results.sql: SELECT day_of_week, AVG(delay_seconds) / 60.0 AS avg_delay_minutes, COUNT(*) AS sample_size FROM liveboard_records GROUP BY day_of_week HAVING COUNT(*) >= 100 ORDER BY avg_delay_minutes DESC LIMIT 1;

results.question: How many stop events were scheduled on 2026-08-05?
results.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS stop_events_count FROM liveboard_records WHERE "Scheduled Date" = '2026-08-05';

results.question: What is the average delay in minutes for each hour of the day?
results.sql: SELECT "Hour", AVG(delay_seconds) / 60.0 AS avg_delay_minutes, COUNT(*) AS sample_size FROM liveboard_records GROUP BY "Hour" ORDER BY "Hour" LIMIT 24;

results.question: Which 5 stations, among those with at least 100 stop events, have the highest average delay?
results.sql: SELECT "Stations Name", AVG(delay_seconds) / 60.0 AS avg_delay_minutes, COUNT(*) AS sample_size FROM liveboard_records GROUP BY "Stations Name" HAVING COUNT(*) >= 100 ORDER BY avg_delay_minutes DESC LIMIT 5;

results.question: How many different stations appear in the stop events?
results.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "Stations Name") AS station_count FROM liveboard_records;

results.question: How many distinct vehicle ids are there in the stop events?
results.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT vehicle_id) AS distinct_vehicle_count FROM liveboard_records;

results.question: What is the average delay in minutes on Saturdays and Sundays combined?
results.sql: SELECT AVG(delay_seconds) / 60.0 AS avg_delay_minutes FROM liveboard_records WHERE day_of_week IN ('Saturday', 'Sunday');

results.question: How many stop events had a delay of more than 30 minutes?
results.sql: SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN delay_seconds > 1800 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS delayed_count FROM liveboard_records;

results.question: Which train category (e.g. IC, S, L) has the most delays?
results.sql: SELECT COALESCE(r.train_category, 'Unknown') AS train_category, AVG(lr.delay_seconds) / 60.0 AS avg_delay_minutes, COUNT(*) AS sample_size FROM liveboard_records lr LEFT JOIN trips t ON lr.vehicle_id = t.trip_id LEFT JOIN routes r ON t.route_id = r.route_id GROUP BY train_category HAVING COUNT(*) >= 100 ORDER BY avg_delay_minutes DESC LIMIT 1;

results.question: How many stop events were made by IC trains?
results.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS ic_stop_events FROM liveboard_records lr LEFT JOIN trips t ON lr.vehicle_id = t.trip_id LEFT JOIN routes r ON t.route_id = r.route_id WHERE r.train_category = 'IC';

results.question: On which date was the average delay the highest?
results.sql: SELECT "Scheduled Date", AVG(delay_seconds) / 60.0 AS avg_delay_minutes, COUNT(*) AS sample_size FROM liveboard_records GROUP BY "Scheduled Date" HAVING COUNT(*) >= 100 ORDER BY avg_delay_minutes DESC LIMIT 1;

results.question: What percentage of stop events at Bruxelles-Midi were on time?
results.sql: SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN "Delay Severity" = 'On Time (<2min)' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 1) AS on_time_rate_pct FROM liveboard_records WHERE "Stations Name" = 'Bruxelles-Midi';

results.question: Compare the average delay in minutes between Bruxelles-Central and Bruxelles-Midi.
results.sql: SELECT "Stations Name", AVG(delay_seconds) / 60.0 AS avg_delay_minutes FROM liveboard_records WHERE "Stations Name" IN ('Bruxelles-Central', 'Bruxelles-Midi') GROUP BY "Stations Name" LIMIT 20;

results.question: What hour of the day has the most delays?
results.sql: SELECT "Hour", AVG(delay_seconds) / 60.0 AS avg_delay_minutes, COUNT(*) AS sample_size FROM liveboard_records GROUP BY "Hour" HAVING COUNT(*) >= 100 ORDER BY avg_delay_minutes DESC LIMIT 1;

results.question: How many stop events were scheduled at Gand-Saint-Pierre in hours 7, 8 and 9?
results.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS stop_events FROM liveboard_records WHERE "Stations Name" = 'Gand-Saint-Pierre' AND "Hour" IN (7,8,9);

results.question: What was the average delay in minutes over the last 7 days of data?
results.sql: SELECT AVG(delay_seconds) / 60.0 AS avg_delay_minutes FROM liveboard_records WHERE "Scheduled Date" >= (SELECT DATE(MAX("Scheduled Date"), '-6 days') FROM liveboard_records);

results.question: List the 3 longest delays at Liège-Guillemins, in minutes.
results.sql: SELECT record_id, vehicle_id, delay_seconds / 60.0 AS delay_minutes FROM liveboard_records WHERE "Stations Name" = 'Liège-Guillemins' ORDER BY delay_seconds DESC LIMIT 3;

results.question: How many stations have an average delay above 5 minutes, counting only stations with at least 100 stop events?
results.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS stations_above_5min FROM (SELECT "Stations Name" FROM liveboard_records GROUP BY "Stations Name" HAVING COUNT(*) >= 100 AND AVG(delay_seconds) / 60.0 > 5);

results.question: What are the first and last dates covered by the data?
results.sql: SELECT MIN("Scheduled Date") AS first_date, MAX("Scheduled Date") AS last_date FROM liveboard_records;

results.question: How many stop events were canceled in the whole dataset?
results.sql: SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN canceled = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS canceled_count FROM liveboard_records;

results.question: What percentage of stop events at Namur were Severe?
results.sql: SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN "Delay Severity" = 'Severe (>15min)' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 1) AS severe_pct FROM liveboard_records WHERE "Stations Name" = 'Namur';

results.question: Which station, among those with at least 100 stop events, has the lowest average delay?
results.sql: SELECT "Stations Name", AVG(delay_seconds) / 60.0 AS avg_delay_minutes, COUNT(*) AS sample_size FROM liveboard_records GROUP BY "Stations Name" HAVING COUNT(*) >= 100 ORDER BY avg_delay_minutes ASC LIMIT 1;

results.question: Give the average delay in minutes for each date, in date order.
results.sql: SELECT "Scheduled Date", AVG(delay_seconds) / 60.0 AS avg_delay_minutes FROM liveboard_records GROUP BY "Scheduled Date" ORDER BY "Scheduled Date" LIMIT 100;

results.question: How many stop events were scheduled on Mondays?
results.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS monday_stop_events FROM liveboard_records WHERE day_of_week = 'Monday';

results.question: How many stop events had no delay at all?
results.sql: SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN delay_seconds = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS no_delay_count FROM liveboard_records;

results.question: What is the average delay in minutes for stop events in hours 17, 18 and 19?
results.sql: SELECT AVG(delay_seconds) / 60.0 AS avg_delay_minutes FROM liveboard_records WHERE "Hour" IN (17, 18, 19);
